Other Events On August 18, 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from LUCIDITY, a 78-participant, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of avexitide, an investigational, first-in-class glucagon-like peptide-1 (“GLP-1”) receptor antagonist, in participants with post-bariatric hypoglycemia (“PBH”) following Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (“RYGB”) surgery.
